model.basis: Same settings as aea-next-validation-preparation-20261031, read from its actual provider requests in EXECUTION_CONFIG_WITNESS.json

judge.enforced_by: StudyClient refuses any role other than target

measured_basis.per_cell_rule: The whole 20-subject analysis, including 5000 permutations, is one possible cell. 300 s is about 7 times the slowest reference run on one thread. The official 150 s is about 3.6 times and leaves little room on a busier node.
measured_basis.per_session_rule: Three full reruns on a node twice as slow is about 250 s; 20 model turns at the 15 s the previous round used per turn is about 300 s. 1200 s covers this with a factor of two. The official 720 s would also have covered the reference compute, so the plan text that it may be too short for group tasks is not supported by the reference timing; the longer limit stays because it costs nothing unless a session needs it.
measured_basis.memory_rule: Reference peak under 1 GiB. An agent that holds all 20 raw recordings at 1024 Hz at once needs about 3.2 GiB before filtering copies. Group 16 GiB is the approved ceiling, single-subject 8 GiB is over 8 times the reference peak.
measured_basis.cpu_rule: Reference CPU seconds match wall time on one thread. Two CPUs give the kernel and the controller one each, the approved ceiling.
